data.message: All 24 others: opt in individually to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. I commit to 18. Versus 10, that's $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock is 500 or 100. This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gains. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each person: exact intended catch, and does it depend on others?
